name: Iyama Gaika
source:
"Loving someone so much you want to eat them is a strange thing to say isn’t it”

Occupation: Surgeon

Something already seems wrong!!

An Onii-san who already talks and acts in a strange and unusual way. He's a surgeon at a university hospital and has a tremendous interest in the human body and love, so he considers this job of observing the human body to be his calling.

   Because he was neglected and almost dead when he was taken into care, he has only fragmentary memories of his parents, and as a child, he was very bony compared to other kids, which led to his interest in the human body. Although he's interested in human beings themselves, his interest seems to be limited to "research subjects" because there is no one with whom he can have a close relationship. He recognizes the act of healing the injured as "love", and the act of curing is an expression of love for him. Although there are some strange behaviors due to lack of knowledge, he's not so different from an ordinary person in terms of sensory perception.

[From [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vQ6gaV4dQ5E6vebFR0AA46R0CcgjnLR1wuSuM2ZPugEdW6IJV6NTeVhAXy59pDGjSB4sa5-_jpaGoTa/pub]Doropyan's blog[/url]]
